title: set_item_properties result
description: What set_item_properties returns: one outcome per entry in the call's changes array, in the order they were supplied, using the action array outcome shape from messages/tool-result-partial.schema.json. The whole array ran inside one undo block and what succeeded is kept, so a partial outcome leaves exactly one undo entry reverting what did land. undoPositionBefore is optional and its absence is meaningful: it is reported whenever any change was applied, so a result without it is a call in which nothing changed and no undo marker was recorded.

items.description: The items that were changed, with their bounds after the change. Only the successful entries appear here. Carried alongside the outcomes because trimming adjusts where an item starts and ends, and the resulting length is what the producer hears — it is not derivable from the request, since a trim is clamped by the underlying audio.

actions.description: One entry per action in the call's action array, in the order the actions were supplied, so the agent can match an outcome to what it asked for.

actionOutcome.description: The outcome of one action in the array, as one of two closed shapes. Split on success rather than carrying an optional error field so that "this action failed" and "here is why" cannot come apart: a failed action without a reason is a schema violation, not something the agent has to cope with at runtime.

oneOf.description: An action that failed, which must say why.

ok.description: False for an action that was not applied.

actionTarget.description: What the action addressed, identified as the resolved REAPER GUID where the action targeted an object, so the agent can retry precisely rather than re-resolving a name pattern that may now be ambiguous.

actionError.description: Why one action failed. Required on a failed action, because "something went wrong" is not enough for the agent to tell the producer what to do next.

code.description: Machine-readable failure cause for this action.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this action's failure.

itemPlacement.description: Where a media item sits after the call, carrying the track it is on as well as its bounds. The track GUID is included because an item can be moved between tracks, so "where is it now" is two questions.

name.description: Name of the item's active take, which is what REAPER shows on the item.

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

timelinePosition.description: A position on the project timeline, in seconds from the start.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.
